new_articles.title: Coupang files lawsuits over $462 million in South Korea fines over data breach
new_articles.summary: Coupang 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Coupang files lawsuits over $462 million in South Korea fines over data breach'이다. Channel NewsAsia is an English-language news organization based in Singapore. SEOUL, Oct 8 : E-commerce firm Coupang said on Thursday it has filed two administrative lawsuits against 620 billion won ($462. 75 million) in fines imposed by South Korea's government over a data breach. The US-listed company confirmed the filing in a text message to Reuters. ($1 = 1,339. 8200 won).

matched_articles.summary: HYBE 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'HYBE to host Weverse Con Festival in New Delhi in March 2027'이다. First international edition will feature K-pop and Indian artists, with tickets exclusively on BookMyShow. com/companies/hybe-to-host-weverse-con-festival-in-new-delhi-in-march-2027/article71556896 ece South Korean entertainment giant HYBE will host the first international edition of its Weverse Con Festival in New Delhi on 27–28 March 2027, marking the event’s debut outside South Korea The two-day festival will feature a mixed line-up of K-pop and Indian artists, along with collaborative stages and fan engagement activations tied to HYBE’s Weverse platform HYBE Chief Executive Officer Jason Jaesang Lee described the festival as part of the company’s “multi-home, multi-genre” strategy, with India identified as a priority growth market The announcement comes alongside HYBE’s broader India push through HYBE INDIA, its Mumbai-based strategic office, which has been running nationwide talent auditions and developing locally produced content aimed at global distribution. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
